facts.fact: Importer package chunker (ChunkMarkdown, ChunkText) configured by Budget with fields Target, Max, MinFill, MinTail, Context.
ChunkMarkdown returns chunks and document title from first-level heading; no first-level heading, title empty.
Markdown chunks carry HeadingPath joining nested heading titles with " > ", e.g. "Guide > Setup > Docker".
Heading starts new chunk only after current chunk reaches minimum fill (MinFill); otherwise heading stays in same chunk.
Fenced code blocks (``` and ~~~, including nested shorter fences inside longer ~~~~ fence) never split across chunks.
ChunkMarkdown treats setext heading underlined with === as heading: test expects HeadingPath "Title" and title "Title". The test does not separately assert --- underline.
Oversized paragraph split at line boundaries first, then sentences, then runes as last resort, without losing text.
Tail chunk smaller than MinTail tokens merged back into previous chunk.
Chunk's Context is tail of previous chunk's text, cut at line start; first chunk has empty Context.
ChunkText splits plain text on blank lines only, ignoring markdown headings, gives chunks empty HeadingPath.
Every chunker test case: each chunk's Index must equal its position, Tokens must not exceed Budget.Max. Preserving all source text apart from whitespace checked only in cases flagged noLoss.
